turns.user: Saint, tell me about Twilight Gap.
turns.agent: Welcome to Twilight Gap. The place where humanity nearly died.
We would have lost if not for Shaxx's last stand. With Nkechi and Adbi and Truce. Liu Feng. Ana. They all believed in him.
I have never known him to give up. Ever. He's taught me a lot.
A Titan is only as good as his word.
